title: Senior/ Principal Manager Medical & Scientific Writing*
description: OVERVIEW We are currently seeking a Senior or Principal Manager Medical & Scientific Writing* to join our Clinical Sciences team with a primary focus on Phase III clinical trials and Biologics License Application (BLA) submissions. You will work in Tübingen, Munich or remote within Germany in an interdisciplinary environment with colleagues from clinical and non-clinical teams and will contribute to our mission of delivering novel PRAME immunotherapies to patients with cancer. This position is offered on a fixed-term contract for 24 months. YOUR MISSION As a part of cross-functional teams, you will independently manage assigned medical writing activities mainly for late-stage clinical trials and associated regulatory submissions. Your main responsibilities will include but are not limited to the following tasks: Plan, author and coordinate clinical documents for BLA submissions ensuring a consistent presentation and interpretation of clinical data across documents. Prepare regulatory documents supporting Phase 3 as well as early clinical trials, clinical trial applications in Europe, and IND submissions in the USA, including clinical trial protocols and amendments, investigator’s brochures, and clinical sections of Investigational Medicinal Product Dossiers. Prepare briefing books for scientific advice meetings in Europe and the USA including meetings supporting late-stage development and BLA submission planning. Write medical and scientific sections, develop document strategies and coordinate cross-functional input, reviews and comment resolution. Manage document timelines, dependencies and deliverables to meet study and submission milestones. Provide medical writing oversight of external writers and vendors, including review of document plans and drafts, coordination of feedback, and monitoring of quality and timelines.
